channel.description: Threats Before Coffee is a daily briefing on the stories that matter in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and the tech world - including the geopolitics and money behind them. Only the important stuff, every morning, 7 days a week. Fully AI-produced: stories are researched and verified by Claude and voiced with NotebookLM Audio Overviews. Sources for every episode are in the show notes.

item.title: AI hackers hit Check Point, CIA system breached, CrowdStrike buys Zscaler
item.description:
Welcome to the very first episode of Threats Before Coffee: the cyber, AI and tech stories that matter, before your first coffee.

In this episode:

  • AI-assisted attackers compromise Check Point management servers at 22 organizations - BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek
  • China-linked group chains PHP2Shell and Fragnesia to root Palo Alto firewalls - SecurityWeek
  • UK NCSC: AI-driven attacks expose years of weak security - TechCrunch
  • Unclassified CIA/ODNI intelligence analysis system breached - CyberScoop, SecurityWeek/AP
  • CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for ~$43.9B - CrowdStrike
  • Jensen Huang's first day back at Nvidia; Huawei convicted; Megaspeed blacklisted - CNBC, CNBC
  • Patch watch: VMware vCenter CVE-2026-123903, Drupal CVE-2026-132165, N-able MailAssure - The Hacker News, SecurityWeek
  • OpenAI and Cisco release Shirudo - OpenAI
  • Anthropic slips below its IPO price - CNBC
  • Quick hits: Rackspace Spot shutdown, Radware breach, Azure API Management abuse in Norway, tankers hacked, OpenAI's matrix multiplication preprint

Threats Before Coffee is produced with AI: research and scripts by Claude (Anthropic), voices by NotebookLM. Always check the sources before acting.
